brief:
Bezalel Eisenkot's political bloc is moving to form a government by courting ultra-Orthodox parties, according to Al Jazeera English, even as Israel's military campaign in Gaza continues and Palestinian communities face ongoing settler violence. The political maneuvers represent a significant reshuffle of Israeli leadership amid the broader conflict.

The negotiations proceed as military operations persist in Gaza alongside intensified settler actions against Palestinian communities in the occupied territories.
dek: As Eisenkot’s bloc moves to form a government and courts the ultra-Orthodox, Gaza genocide and settler pogroms continue.
title: Eisenkot bloc courts ultra-Orthodox parties amid Gaza war, settlements surge
